subject: Warm pass — CobaltHealth implementation playbook & pre-kickoff config asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@cobalthealth.io>, Asha Singh <asha.singh@cobalthealth.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: CobaltHealth — warm pass and initial config asks

Karthik / Vanessa,

Quick warm pass on CobaltHealth (signed last week). High-level: 3-month pilot (starts onboarding), expected peak usage ~350 reqs/min at 2k token avg. Sales committed a small dedicated pool (3xA10G) for predictable latency. Key commercial: SOW attached (cobalt_sow_v1.pdf) and HubSpot deal link below.

What we need answered before kickoff:
- Confirm single technical POC (name + email) for network/firewall allowlist and test data.
- Confirm whether they need EU data residency for logs (they do not; US region ok per initial conversation).
- Network: firewall egress and IP allowlist (I asked them to share a table — see CC).
- Production target latency SLO: 300ms 95th for the primary inference route.
- Token economics: estimate of monthly tokens (sales estimate ~450M tokens/month).

Attachments: cobalt_sow_v1.pdf, redwood-init-config.yaml
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321

Ask: Karthik, can you own the onboarding? If so, please confirm kickoff date availability next week (I suggested Tue 7/27). Vanessa — flag any CS intake items we should add.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: cobalt_sow_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 312KB)
Attachment: redwood-init-config.yaml (text/yaml, 6KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CobaltHealth — warm pass and initial config asks

Thanks Ben — I can take point for onboarding. Confirming support for a Tue 2026-07-27 kickoff (10:00 PT tentative) unless the customer proposes otherwise.

Internal notes / constraints for CS handoff (please keep internal):
- Dedicated capacity: sales committed 3 GPUs; engineering needs formal reservation request by EOD 7/22 to secure pool.
- Model variant: they requested the optimized-13B-int8 profile for lower cost — ops to verify perf at 2k tokens.
- Expected test dataset size: ~6k sample prompts for regressions; will run evals during sprint0.
- Integration: they'll call inference via VPN + allowlisted IPs; need network diagram and test CIDR prior to staging access.
- Billing: pricing in SOW is pilot-rate with conversion clause on month 3 — finance to confirm billing trigger.

Pre-kickoff checklist (action items I will own and want filled before kickoff):
1) Customer POC name + emails for infra & procurement.
2) Firewall table (egress ports, outbound IPs) — ask they populate the CSV template.
3) Test data + example prompt set (anonymized).
4) Signing of the execution SOW (if any redlines remain).

Ben — loop in procurement contact if SOW still needs final counters. Vanessa — I'll add these to the intake doc and schedule a 30-min pre-kick with customer and eng.

Karthik
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Note: internal only reply (no external recipients).

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CobaltHealth — warm pass and initial config asks

Nice — thanks for owning this, Karthik. Adding a compact CS intake I prepared (see attached checklist). Highlights:
- Sprint0 scope: staging endpoint + smoke tests, latency regression, and onboarding playbook review.
- Roles: Karthik (Implementation Lead), Vanessa (Delivery PM), Customer POC (tbd), Eng Oncall (auto-assigned).
- Data handling: confirm whether they will upload PHI in test dataset; if yes, we need an approved data handling plan and a gated staging environment.
- Security items: SOC2 evidence pack request (if procurement asks, we should have the pack link ready).

I'll draft the 30-min pre-kick agenda and send a calendar invite once we have POC contact. Ben — can you chase the network CSV from the customer today? I added a brief onboarding risks list to the intake doc.

Vanessa Ortiz
Delivery Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Ben — and hi Karthik / Vanessa,

We can confirm a kickoff on Tue 7/27 at 10:00 PT. I am the technical POC (Jamie Park, jamie.park@cobalthealth.io). Asha (procurement) is CC'ed for SOW finalize / PO. I've attached the firewall table (network-firewall-table.csv) with our egress ranges and NAT IPs. Procurement — procurement@cobalthealth.io is the billing contact; they will follow up on the DocuSign.

1) We will not include PHI in the pilot dataset — everything will be synthetic/anonymized.
2) Can you confirm the staging allowlist IPs for your egress and whether we need to open any additional ports beyond 443?

Looking forward — please send the calendar invite and any pre-kick meeting materials.

Jamie Park
